data.subject: Weekly CI Brief — 3 moves, 1 prediction (May 2–8)
data.body:
Competitive intel, week of May 2–8:

1. **Competitor A** — dropped seat pricing from $29 to $24/seat (18% cut). Public pricing page updated May 4. Likely responding to churn after their Q1 earnings call. Your positioning: 'enterprise-grade at startup pricing.'

2. **Competitor C** — launched usage-based SKU on May 6. Blog post + changelog confirm. Pricing: $0.08/event with a $500/mo floor. Your counter: you already have outcome-based pricing on Pro tier.

3. **Competitor B** — no public moves yet, but they posted 3 pricing-manager jobs in the last 2 weeks. Prediction: 60-day window before they follow with a pricing change.

12 sources attached, all retrievable.

― Whitfield (via Theo Kapoor, operator)
